title: AMD action: getupdatedproviders
description: List in-practice providers added, modified, or deleted since an ISO 8601 since timestamp (delta-sync feed). Returns since, include_profiles, count, by_updatestatus, by_specialty, and a providers list. providers rows: provider_id, name, code, npi, specialty, updatestatus, changedat, createdat. Off-peak Tier 1.

include_profiles.description: If true, include each provider's profilelist.

since.description: Saved servertime from previous response (datechanged); ISO 8601.
